about: Renders content that a screen reader announces and the browser does not paint.

focusable.about: A page section whose first control, Keyboard shortcuts, is hidden until keyboard focus. Press Tab into the scene: `focusable` fixes the control to the start corner of the section.
focusable.title: Focusable

name.about: An icon-only close button. The icon has `aria-hidden`, and the hidden text Close is the button's accessible name.
name.title: Accessible name

title: Visually hidden
